<thought>We need to find a template that matches an SN2 substitution breaking a C‑Cl bond (atomic numbers 6‑17) and forming a C‑N bond (6‑7). Using the valid functional group names, we will search the template catalog with these criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-17"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-7"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
